svg.title: FlickrGroupAddr Publish PNG + Add to Groups
svg.desc: The authoritative simplified happy-path interaction map for local FGA Album setup and group selection, FGA LrC plugin authentication, Lightroom Classic PNG rendering, direct Flickr upload, verified photo binding, and durable add-only group submission.

text.tspan: FlickrGroupAddr Publish PNG + Add to Groups
User adds one or more photos
Plugin Code from LrC Password Store.
FGA API backend verifies via getInfo;

Authority: Normative happy-path interaction map (ADRs 0005–0007, 0041); one photo; zero groups skip 16–19; PNG direct to Flickr; 202 = durable handoff; group handling is add-only and fail-polite. Contracts own omitted Album, failure, and recovery detail.
